title: Prem Prasad Acharya’s individual self-immolation
reason: Not a gathering/protest event: the reported action was an individual self-immolation; later street protest by other people is separately represented as E003.
notes: S013 body lines 105–106 dates the individual act to Jan 24 and distinguishes the subsequent Jan 25 crowd march. Do not attribute the individual act to protester violence or count it as a mobilized gathering.
